subject: M4 Infinite streaming chunks + world persistence
description: Measured vanilla worldgen surface: 963 files / 14 dirs — 262 placed_feature, 226 configured_feature, 63 noise, 35 density_function, 40 processor_list, 7 noise_settings, 5 configured_carver, plus 3 bundled datapacks. Today the world is a fixed 13x13 chunk island (src/world.ts:12 REGION_RADIUS=6), every column allocates the full 384-block height (~290 KB/chunk, ~49 MB total), one block edit remeshes a 3x3 neighbourhood of full-height meshes and relights a 41^3 box (src/main.ts:85-86), nothing persists across reload and time restarts at tick 1000. Work: 16^3 sectioned chunk storage with a sparse palette, LRU load/unload around the player, generation and meshing in a Web Worker pool, per-section dirty rebuild with neighbour edge merging, view distance to 32 with proper fog coupling, chunk streaming protocol compatible with the Paper bridge, world save/load (IndexedDB or OPFS) including block edits, entities, time and player state, and a real region file format for later export.
